name: bandit.r033_registered_smoke_callback_mcw
description: Current-source R-033 successor: an isolated active native smoke item is held across the first authoritative staffed-observer cadence from a separately audited registered idle camp. Fixture registration and item activation are zero credit. The run must preserve the first source-bound scan and the following actual callback/lead result without conflating other channels.

proof_gates.label: R-033 registered smoke callback reaches one current source-bound live session

steps.label: operate_r033_registered_smoke_callback
steps.objective: Audit the zero-credit registered empty site, its exact at-home observer, the active smoke item's expiry over the next cadence, native emission, production scan, and the first staffed-observer callback/lead result.
proof_targets: registered idle site and observer identity
native smoke emission with authoritative in-range field state
first callback and durable lead/rejection state
authority: advertised native actions and worker-chosen waits
invariants: registration and item activation are zero-credit

evidence_contract.claim: one source-bound R-033 run supplies only independently observed isolated smoke-to-staffed-callback facts
evidence_contract.failure_rule: a conflating source, missing binding, missing registered observer identity, or missing callback facts leaves the affected claim unproved
